node: Inspection, metrology, yield management, and process-control tools for advanced nodes, HBM, packaging, and PCBs
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the US-listed universe for the semiconductor process-control node. KLA is the obvious reference leader across wafer, reticle, IC, packaging, and PCB process control. The underfollowed lane should prioritize Camtek, Onto Innovation, and Nova because they have more concentrated inspection/metrology exposure to advanced packaging, wafer-level packaging, inline process control, or yield-management workflows that become more valuable as AI accelerators, HBM, chiplets, and substrates increase manufacturing complexity. No buy/sell view is implied. Layer 1B expanded the US-listed universe around the process-control chokepoint. KLA remains the obvious reference leader for wafer, reticle, packaging, and PCB process control. The more underfollowed lane is concentrated in smaller or mid-sized public vendors with advanced-packaging/HBM inspection, metrology, and yield-data exposure: Camtek, Onto Innovation, and PDF Solutions. These names map to the hypothesis that AI-driven chip complexity, HBM, chiplets, hybrid bonding, and advanced packaging raise the economic value of defect detection, metrology, and yield analytics across multiple semiconductor winners rather than a single AI-chip design. Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around semiconductor process-control intensity created by AI chip complexity.
